messages:
morgan: quick sync — landing copy pass for launch. need concise hero lines and role-specific CTAs for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private. also define inbound routing from launch posts + webinar signups.

deepa: agreed. keeping hero focused on performance, predictable cost, and deployment modes. drafted short variants below.

alex: CTA mapping: social posts -> webinar -> role gating -> demo/try flows. paid channels should map straight to free credits or pricing.

sam: UI plan: 2-line hero + subhead, three CTAs. primary for Hosted should be self-serve, Dedicated primary CTA goes to capacity request, Private to calendar.

julia: webinar gating idea: capture role (engineer, platform, security). tailor followups: engineers get SDK quickstart, platform gets capacity questionnaire, security gets compliance packet and CISO invite.

ben: HubSpot implementation: add hidden field mode_intent (hosted/dedicated/private) and utm_campaign. route with workflows to growth/SDR/AE queues.

morgan: concrete deliverables requested: 1) hero copy per mode 2) three CTAs per mode 3) inbound routing matrix for site + webinar 4) launch post snippets for social/blog linking to correct funnel.

deepa: Hero copy drafts:
- Hosted: "Ship LLM features fast with low-latency hosted inference." / sub: "Start with our API and scale without managing GPUs."
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools for predictable production throughput." / sub: "SLA-backed capacity and isolated resources."
- Private: "Inference where your network and data stay in your control." / sub: "VPC and on-prem deployments for regulated workloads."

alex: Recommended CTAs (short):
- Hosted: ["Start free", "View API docs", "See pricing"]
- Dedicated: ["Request capacity", "View SLAs", "Get estimate"]
- Private: ["Book a meeting", "Compliance brief", "Deployment options"]

sam: design note: primary CTA styling depends on mode intent. ensure visual parity across variants and 3-button layout for accessibility.

julia: Webinar follow-up cadence: immediate role-specific asset, +2 days case study, +7 days demo invite or free credit nudge. make role optional on form; progressive profile in emails.

ben: HubSpot mapping snippet example (for engineers):
properties: email=form.email, mode_intent=form.mode || "hosted", role=form.role, utm_campaign=form.utm_campaign
workflows: if mode_intent=hosted -> tag hosted-funnel -> notify growth; dedicated -> tag dedicated-sales -> SDR; private -> tag private-ps -> AE+SE.

morgan: launch-post copy — 3 themes (product, economics, reliability). keep <120 chars and include link + CTA. deepa please produce 3 variants per theme for A/B.

deepa: samples: product: "Run state-of-the-art LLMs at scale — hosted, dedicated, or in your VPC. Try the API. [link]"; economics: "Lower per-token cost with smart batching and caching. Start with free credits. [link]"; reliability: "SLAs, reserved capacity, and fallbacks to keep apps online. Request capacity. [link]"

alex: social targeting: Hosted posts link to signup/docs; Dedicated/Private launch posts link to triage form with mode_intent default. track utm_mode param.

sam: design checklist: three CTAs in hero, inline benchmark callout, customer logos, consistent microcopy for legal and privacy. i'll sync Figma and export CTA assets.

julia: gating tradeoff: role field optional reduces friction. recommend optional role with email followups to collect more profile data.

ben: one more practical: ensure HubSpot form returns mode_intent even if users click straight CTA. add ?mode=hosted|dedicated|private to page links.

morgan: actions: deepa finalize copy + post variants (EOD); sam update Figma + export buttons (tomorrow); ben implement HubSpot mapping & workflows (tomorrow); julia draft webinar email flows (next day); alex schedule A/B tests and channels. reconvene after drafts.

marketing-bot: Reminder set for follow-up: 4987659935 (in 24 hours) :spiral_calendar:

morgan: thanks all — excited to get these live. :rocket:
